Our platform also integrates with other systems and applications, creating a connective layer for organizations that links departments and bridges information silos.
On top of our platform, we have a product suite to address the needs of specific industries and use cases, including monday work management, monday CRM, monday dev, and monday service. All of our core products have undergone AI enhancements in 2025 to align with our mission of building software that executes work on behalf of users. Also, in 2025, monday CRM expanded from a single product into a CRM product suite, with the addition of the AI-powered monday campaigns product.
We have a strong history of technological innovation, as we regularly release new building blocks and make frequent updates to our platform for performance and scale. We have also incorporated AI capabilities platform-wide, including both product-specific features and standalone offerings.
